caseNameFull: Landman, Superintendent of the Five Civilized Tribes v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. Huston Thompson and Oscar P. Mast for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. J. Louis Monarch and Bernard Chertcoff for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied. Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
